factors.off_tolerance_cycles: 3 or 4 depending on whether the approved reduction is applied

deciding.under_dosed: Metered 28.3 L against 40 L raw plan is 71%, but an approved 20% reduction gives 32 L, so 88%. This sits close to the 90% line and both readings are defensible.
deciding.emitter_clogging: Pressure is at spec (2.0-2.1 bar) and valve_open_s is the full 600 s, yet delivered is only 6.9-7.3 L per cycle (about 0.07 L per dripper) and drain is about 5%. That is low flow with normal pressure.
deciding.next_action: Meter and controller totals match, no catch test is pending, and the reduction is approved. This leans toward sign-off, with doubt left by the low drain and the delivered volume still under the reduced plan.
deciding.drain_deviation: Mean drain is 4.8% against a 20-30% band, so it is 15.2 points below. That is right at the 15-point line between marked and severe.
deciding.off_plan_cycles: Against the 8 L reduced plan, delivered of 6.9, 7.0 and 7.1 L are more than 10% off and 7.3 L is within it (3 cycles). Against the raw 10 L plan all four are off. The count is 3 or 4, which straddles the level 2/3 boundary.
